title: balance ability read model
description: The abilityId -> normalized type effects read model consumed by BALANCE_ABILITIES_PATH (ADR-0017 §2). This machine-checks the shape defined by the ADRs (the ADRs stay the source of truth; ADR-0402), which the data lane's `pokedex export` should satisfy; services/balance/internal/master/abilities.go is the executable version of the same contract. Not expressible here: abilityId must be unique across `abilities` entries; within one ability, effects must not have more than one immune/absorb effect for the same attackType; numerator/denominator are an integer ratio that need not be in lowest terms (2/4 is accepted); the loader reduces it (to 1/2) when it stores the effect. For `super_effective_multiplier`, an explicit `attackType: null` is rejected here although the loader treats it as absent. Integral decimals such as `2.0` pass JSON Schema `integer` but the loader rejects them; exporters must write plain integers. None of these are expressible as JSON Schema constraints; the loader enforces them.

factor.description: The numerator or denominator of a type_multiplier/super_effective_multiplier factor. 1..16, not necessarily reduced (see the top-level description).

effects.description: May be empty: an ability without any type-related effect (ADR-0017 §2).

effect.description: Numerator/denominator both null is treated as absent by the loader (same laxity as an omitted key); this schema treats an explicit null as present (and therefore, for immune/absorb, rejects it), which is stricter than the loader for that one edge case.
